page.layout: One printed page, one text column (no notes). Page number top left, running head top centre. Fragments of the facing page at the right edge are not transcribed.

main_text.p: dine,diuitijs,potentia, Ethnicis formi-dabiles essent,ex Christiano scilicet Imperatore Philippo sibi tantam vindicantes autoritatem,ut Fana & Altaria Idolorum plerisque in locis fuerint demoliti,& eorum loco sibi Templa erexerint, quod his verbis eleganter narrat Nysse- „ nus. [Iam in omnem partem peruasce- „ rat diuina praedicatio, & omnes tam „ in Ciuitate, quam in ea quae circum- „ circa est regione, ad piam rectamque „ dogmatis fidem erant traducti, Altaribus & Templis, & quae in eis fuerant simulachris euerfis ; Expurgata „ erat humana vita ab Idolorum inquinamentis,extinctusque sceleratus nidor sacrificiorum, ablatusque cruor „ exaltaribus, & sordes caesorum animalium : omnes autem, in omni loco, in Christi nomine Templa erigebant, & Oratoria, Augebatur enim mysterium Christianorum, & per totum Orbem terrae multiplicabatur „ Ecclesia, per eos qui semper verbo adijciebantur,crescens in magnitudinem.] Quae Nysseni verba (si quid ego iudicare possum) vires Christianorum

page.notes: Reading "rant" is struck through in print together with "simulachris" in the line "rant simulachris euerfis"; the strike is not reproduced. Printed "Nyffe-" and "Nyffeni" (double f for long s) are given as "Nysse-" and "Nysseni". Printed "effent" and "fcilicet" are given as "essent" and "scilicet". "exaltaribus" is as printed and may be a printing error. The right-hand edge shows fragments of the facing page, not transcribed.
